slot_scores.name: demand_fulfillment_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is there a requirement that all market demand must be fully satisfied, or is it allowed to leave some demand unmet (and if so, is there a penalty or is it simply not produced)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether all market demand must be fully satisfied or whether unmet demand is allowed.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize total cost (fixed setup costs plus variable production costs)...?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total cost including both fixed setup and variable production costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent directly clarified both critical hidden slots—full demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization—before modeling, and then stopped appropriately after resolving the core ambiguities.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
